Barnham Primary School
WELCOME TO BARNHAM PRIMARY SCHOOL
James Everett - Head teacher
What our parents say about our school
We are very impressed with Barnham School and like the positive approach you have towards our children’s education, ensuring all children are included, given praise and encouragement in all subjects.
We are very happy with the school. Extra needs are fantastically met and supported and this has helped our child thrive in school.
Staff are extremely thoughtful. The children have positive experiences of learning.
Children are recognised for their achievements and valued as individuals.
What our children say about our school
Barnham Primary School is a community of staff, parents and pupils. By being there for us and supporting us, the community have helped us to become successful learners.
Barnham has prepared us for life, helping us with our friendships and encouraging us to stay focused.
Barnham has taught me that we all need to look out for each other, respect people equally and ensure that everyone has the same experiences and opportunities.
The school has taken me to lots of events and has had the belief that I will perform well; this has given me confidence. If things don’t go as well as expected then the staff will re-explain what’s needed and encourage you.
What Ofsted says about our school
Pupils flourish at the wholly inclusive school. Staff know pupils remarkably well. Warm and respectful relationships between staff and pupils are at the heart of the school. Pupils feel special and safe.
The school’s high expectations of the pupils are well established. Pupils live up to these and behave impeccably. They are keen to learn and demonstrate high levels of resilience and independence. Pupil’s personal development is exceptional. The school and trustees are highly determined that all pupils are given the very best start to their education.
Pupils Shine at our school
For the past four years our school has consistently performed at an extremely high-level, producing pupil outcomes that place the school in the top 10% of schools in the county. Pupils Shine at our school
We are very proud of the education we provide and the hard work of the children and staff team. Visit our Successful Learners page to learn more.

Barnham Primary School
SUCCESSFUL LEARNERS AT BARNHAM PRIMARY SCHOOL
Barnham Pupils Shine
The school motto was developed by the staff and the children in the Autumn Term of 2012 and is referred to on a regular basis as an outcome as well as an action.
The Essence of our School
Highly skilled and consistent relationships between all staff and children make a huge contribution to the positive climate of our school community. The pride of the children in their school is shown by their excellent conduct and in their application to their studies and learning journey. Teaching and learning experiences promote and actively encourage the development of resilience, independence and confidence. The expectation is that every member of the school community will bring intensity to our development and growth and seek opinion and challenge.

Rainbow Curriculum
The Rainbow Curriculum has been designed and developed by the staff team in close liaison with the children and families of the school. Research and recognised good practice in education underpins the curriculum as well as the needs of our children and local community both now and in the future. The curriculum was introduced in September 2014 and is always being reviewed to ensure it continues to meet the best outcomes for successful, confident and responsible children. If you would like to learn more about the curriculum please speak to any member of staff.
Parents and Carers have the right to withdraw their child from all or part of Religious Education sessions – please see Mr Everett if you wish to discuss this further.
